title: DesignArena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models | TechCrunch
summary: For non-enterprise users, using DesignArena is a lot like using a sophisticated model router. It too nabbed some frontier models as customers and had, it said, over 1.3 million users, but still couldn’t build a sustainable long-term business.
